fetch_command:
zeus_ai_agent /opt/agrs/build/zeus tools --help 2>/dev/null | grep -i osm || echo 'No OSM tools found in ZEUS CLI' mkdir -p /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/scripts curl -X POST "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter" \
  --max-time 300 \
  -d '[out:xml][timeout:300];
      (
        way["highway"](38.253496,-81.109477,38.420352,-80.902255);
      );
      out body;
      >;
      out skel qt;' \
  -o /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads.osm ls -la /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads.osm && head -50 /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads.osm ogr2ogr -f GPKG \
  /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg \
  /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads.osm \
  lines \
  -oo CONFIG_FILE=/opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/scripts/osmconf.ini \
  -lco SPATIAL_INDEX=YES \
  --config OSM_USE_CUSTOM_INDEXING NO \
  -skipfailures 2>/dev/null || \
ogr2ogr -f GPKG \
  /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg \
  /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads.osm \
  lines \
  -lco SPATIAL_INDEX=YES \
  --config OSM_USE_CUSTOM_INDEXING NO \
  -skipfailures ogrinfo -al -so /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg cat > /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg.json << 'EOF'
{
    "dataset_name": "OpenStreetMap Roads",
    "category": "roads",
    "source": "OpenStreetMap",
    "provider": "OpenStreetMap Contributors",
    "provider_url": "https://www.openstreetmap.org/",
    "coverage_date": "2025-01-27",
    "fetch_date": "2025-01-27T12:00:00Z",
    "fetch_tool": "Overpass API",
    "raw_crs": "EPSG:4326",
    "data_type": "Vector",
    "geometry_type": "LineString",
    "format": "GeoPackage",
    "bbox_wgs84": {
        "west": -81.109477,
        "south": 38.253496,
        "east": -80.902255,
        "north": 38.420352
    },
    "documentation_url": "https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway",
    "license": "ODbL (Open Database License)",
    "attribution": "© OpenStreetMap contributors",
    "notes": "All highway types fetched via Overpass API"
}
EOF ogr2ogr -f GPKG \
  /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg \
  /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg \
  -t_srs EPSG:32617 \
  -clipsrc /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/aoi/aoi.geojson \
  -lco SPATIAL_INDEX=YES \
  -nln roads ogrinfo -al -so /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg FEATURE_COUNT=$(ogrinfo -sql "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roads" /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'COUNT\(\*\).*?=\s*\K[0-9]+' || echo '0')
EXTENT=$(ogrinfo -al -so /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg | grep -A1 'Extent:' | head -1)
FILE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg 2>/dev/null || echo '0')

cat > /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg.json << EOF
{
    "dataset_name": "OpenStreetMap Roads",
    "category": "roads",
    "project": "US-PIPELINE-BRAVO",
    "processing_date": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
    "target_crs": "EPSG:32617",
    "target_crs_name": "WGS 84 / UTM zone 17N",
    "data_type": "Vector",
    "geometry_type": "LineString",
    "format": "GeoPackage",
    "layer_name": "roads",
    "feature_count": "$FEATURE_COUNT",
    "bbox_wgs84": {
        "west": -81.109477,
        "south": 38.253496,
        "east": -80.902255,
        "north": 38.420352
    },
    "operations_applied": [
        {
            "operation": "reproject",
            "tool": "ogr2ogr",
            "source_crs": "EPSG:4326",
            "target_crs": "EPSG:32617"
        },
        {
            "operation": "clip",
            "tool": "ogr2ogr",
            "cutline": "aoi/aoi.geojson"
        }
    ],
    "source_files": [
        {
            "filename": "osm_roads_raw.gpkg",
            "metadata": "osm_roads_raw.gpkg.json"
        }
    ],
    "file_size_bytes": $FILE_SIZE,
    "validation_status": "passed",
    "validation_date": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
    "license": "ODbL (Open Database License)",
    "attribution": "© OpenStreetMap contributors",
    "protocol_version": "1.0"
}
EOF rm -f /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads.osm test -f /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg && \
  test $(stat -c%s /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg) -gt 1000 && \
  echo '✓ Raw GeoPackage exists and has data' || echo '✗ Raw GeoPackage missing or empty' test -f /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/osm_roads_raw.gpkg.json && \
  echo '✓ Raw metadata JSON exists' || echo '✗ Raw metadata JSON missing' test -f /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg && \
  FCOUNT=$(ogrinfo -sql "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM roads" /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'cnt.*?=\s*\K[0-9]+' || echo '0') && \
  test "$FCOUNT" -gt 0 && \
  echo "✓ Processed GeoPackage has $FCOUNT features" || echo '✗ Processed GeoPackage missing or empty' CRS=$(ogrinfo -al -so /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'EPSG:[0-9]+' | head -1) && \
  test "$CRS" = "EPSG:32617" && \
  echo '✓ CRS is correct (EPSG:32617)' || echo "✗ CRS mismatch: $CRS" test -f /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/osm_roads_epsg32617_processed.gpkg.json && \
  echo '✓ Processed metadata JSON exists' || echo '✗ Processed metadata JSON missing' echo '=== Raw files ===' && ls -la /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/raw/ && \
  echo '=== Processed files ===' && ls -la /opt/agrs/Projects/US-PIPELINE-BRAVO/data/vectors/processed/
